notes: 'the which' is rule 77's bare-antecedent arm: the supplied determiner carries no content, so the relativizer heads.
γίνεσθε is an expressed verb, so 'be ye' stays with it and εὐχάριστοι keeps only its own word (rule 2); rule 53's supplied-copula question does not arise.
'let' rides inside the third-person imperative's unit, discontinuously, headed on the lexical verb (rules 15, 17).
